player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in SimpleTak.
On the board, your stones appear as '{player_stone}' and your opponent's stones appear as '{opponent_stone}'.

On your turn, choose one empty cell (by its numbered index) and place your stone there.
For example, '[12]' places your stone in cell 12.

Your objective is to form a continuous path of your stones that connects two opposite edges of the board (top-to-bottom or left-to-right).
